relay.shell.list.empty.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. Rendered when the list SSE is connected and no rows exist; the sibling key carries the pre-connection state.

relay.shell.list.connecting.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.shell.list.connecting.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. Rendered while the list stream has not delivered a first frame; paired with relay.shell.list.empty.

relay.shell.list.section.active.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. The section order and membership come from the daemon; this is only the heading.

relay.shell.list.section.previous.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. The section order and membership come from the daemon; this is only the heading.

relay.shell.list.theme.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. Accessible label for the ◐ theme control; the glyph itself is not translated.

relay.shell.session.waiting.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.shell.session.waiting.note: Owned relay SPA shell chrome. Rendered when the projection stream is connected but has not delivered a frame yet. Projection is daemon jargon for the session's live view/state snapshot, not a graphical projection or prediction. Translate the intended meaning: waiting for the session view to arrive; the connection is already established. Keep the English source unchanged.

relay.shell.usage.stale.note: Disclose may_be_stale from uncheckpointed WAL; do not infer freshness from per-report times.

relay.shell.usage.row.role: complete usage allowance row without a named model family
relay.shell.usage.row.note: Own the entire field order and punctuation, including the separator before the value. {label} is an already localized allowance category; {window} is an already localized time-window label, including Unknown window; {value} is the already localized amount or eligibility/status text. Reorder placeholders and use locale-appropriate punctuation; do not translate their supplied contents again. Used when family_cap is false or the family identifier is unknown, so there must be no empty family parentheses. All parameters are strings; preserve their names.

relay.shell.usage.row_family.role: complete usage allowance row with a named model family
relay.shell.usage.row_family.note: Own the entire field order and punctuation, including parentheses and the separator before the value. {label}, {window}, and {value} are already localized text as in relay.shell.usage.row. {family} is the provider's machine model-family identifier (for example opus), not prose to translate. Reorder all placeholders and use locale-appropriate punctuation. Used only when family_cap is true and the family identifier is known. All parameters are strings; preserve their names.
